content: Druidcraft Transmutation Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create one of the following effects within range.Weather Sensor. You create a Tiny, harmless sensory effect that predicts what the weather will be at your location for the next 24 hours. The effect might manifest as a golden orb for clear skies, a cloud for rain, falling snowflakes for snow, and so on. This effect persists for 1 round.Bloom. You instantly make a flower blossom, a seed pod open, or a leaf bud bloom.Sensory Effect. You create a harmless sensory effect, such as falling leaves, spectral dancing fairies, a gentle breeze, the sound of an animal, or the faint odor of skunk. The effect must fit in a 5-foot Cube.Fire Play. You light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a campfire. Place Measured Template V, S Action Instantaneous 30 ft

author: LVDVg5n3IGEBCWns
content: Sera's Map of the Four Ruins Adventuring Gear A traveler's map of the Misty Forest, creased and rain-spotted. Four ruin sites are inked in a confident hand: a cave-mouth in the hills, a deep wood, a ruined temple, a drowned fen.Beneath them, underlined twice:"Four ruins. One prize. One in four — and no way to know which but to walk in and look."A smaller hand has added, later and less steadily: "A game of roulette, and we only get to spin it the once at a time. Three of these are cold stone and whatever has moved into it. The fourth is the rest of our lives."The caves are circled — and then struck through.

author: LVDVg5n3IGEBCWns
content: Marn's Unsent Letter Adventuring Gear A single sheet folded small enough to live inside a locket — creased sharp, never sealed, never sent. The hand is neat; the margins are smudged by ink-stained fingers."Tess — We are close now. There are four old places in this forest and the prize lies in exactly one of them; the other three are cold stone and whatever has crawled into it. We have Sera's map, and Sera has never been wrong twice. The shrine wasn't a shrine. It was a graveyard! So it is one guess at a time, and we have already spent one. One more ruin — two at the worst — and I am done with this work. I will buy the house by the tannery, the one you liked. Keep well. Do not worry. — M."

author: WjZL43DJHoHpfDrK
content: Brakk's Plate Armor, Claw-Rent Adventuring Gear Ruined plate — cannot be worn as armour in this condition.A full suit of plate, built for a broad, short frame and kept well before the end: the joints still run smooth, the straps and buckles are sound, and the greaves, gauntlets and helm have barely a scratch on them.The breastplate is another matter. Three parallel rents run down it, shoulder to hip, each wide enough to put a hand through. The steel did not dent or buckle the way plate is supposed to fail — it is sheared clean through, in three even lines, and the left pauldron has been torn off its mounting entirely and is missing.Everything below the ruin is salvageable. A working armourer with a forge, a few days, and a supply of good steel could cut out the wrecked plate, beat new sections to match, and make the suit whole again — it would want a proper smith and a proper price, not a field repair.Until then it is 65 pounds of very good steel with a hole in the front of it.

author: WjZL43DJHoHpfDrK
content: The Graveheart Trinket A quarter of a heart, turned to deep red crystal. The size of two cupped hands, the sheared-off vessels still visible like flaws in a gem. It is warm to the touch. It beats — faintly, once every few seconds, light pulsing through the facets. It cannot be chipped or scratched. It has already been broken.The vision. The Graveheart requires attunement. The first time you hold it, it shows you one thing. A beautiful green woman, glowing white, leaves crowning her head, weeping. She closes her hands over her own chest, and her heart bursts. The pieces scatter into the dark, hardening as they fly. The burst drives the mists back in a great ring, baring a bare green valley next to a beautiful lake. Where she stood, a tree: grey, leafless, asleep. A single faint heartbeat, and it is over.While you carry the Graveheart you have advantage on Charisma saving throws.Once between dawns, you can press the shard to the chest of a creature that has died within the last minute: the heart gives one full, warm beat, and it casts revivify — the shard is the only component needed.It is one chamber of a heart — and a heart has four. You cannot shake the feeling that, whole, it could do so much more. Attunement Required Not Equipped Not Proficient

content: The Graveheart Trinket A quarter of a heart, turned to deep red crystal. The size of two cupped hands, the sheared-off vessels still visible like flaws in a gem. It is warm to the touch. It beats — faintly, once every few seconds, light pulsing through the facets. It cannot be chipped or scratched. It has already been broken.The vision. The Graveheart requires attunement. The first time you hold it, it shows you one thing. A beautiful green woman, glowing white, leaves crowning her head, weeping. She closes her hands over her own chest, and her heart bursts. The pieces scatter into the dark, hardening as they fly. The burst drives the mists back in a great ring, baring a bare green valley next to a beautiful lake. Where she stood, a tree: grey, leafless, asleep. A single faint heartbeat, and it is over.While you carry the Graveheart you have advantage on Charisma saving throws.Once between dawns, you can press the shard to the chest of a creature that has died within the last minute: the heart gives one full, warm beat, and it casts revivify — the shard is the only component needed.It is one chamber of a heart — and a heart has four. You cannot shake the feeling that, whole, it could do so much more. Attunement Required Not Equipped Not Proficient

author: WjZL43DJHoHpfDrK
content: Everbloom Petal Junk A single spring blossom, dew still beading on its petals, plucked from a hollow that was blooming in the wrong season. It never wilts and never quite loses its warmth — as though it is holding onto a summer afternoon that ended a very long time ago. It is worth nothing, and it will outlast everyone who carries it.

author: WjZL43DJHoHpfDrK
content: Sera's Map of the Four Ruins Adventuring Gear A traveler's map of the Misty Forest, creased and rain-spotted. Four ruin sites are inked in a confident hand: a cave-mouth in the hills, a deep wood, a ruined temple, a drowned fen.Beneath them, underlined twice:"Four ruins. One prize. One in four — and no way to know which but to walk in and look."A smaller hand has added, later and less steadily: "A game of roulette, and we only get to spin it the once at a time. Three of these are cold stone and whatever has moved into it. The fourth is the rest of our lives."The caves are circled — and then struck through.

author: WjZL43DJHoHpfDrK
content: Charcoal Sketch of a Weeping Woman Adventuring Gear A loose leaf of paper, the charcoal smudged from handling: a woman beneath — or becoming — a great pale tree, her face buried in her hands. Her hair and the branches are drawn as one. It is very good, and it is not finished.Beneath, in a tired hand:"I sketched her so I would stop seeing her face."

author: WjZL43DJHoHpfDrK
content: Marn's Journal Adventuring Gear A rain-stiffened journal wrapped in oilskin. Water has ruined most of it; five entries survive."Greenrest is the kindest town I have known. The mayor fed us for nothing and would take nothing. But four nights running we have all had the same dream — a woman weeping under a white tree. All five of us, the same woman. The apothecary sells a tonic so you won't dream at all. Sera took it and was fine. Maybe we will when we get back.""Started our search through the four possible ruins on Sera's map — the relic is in one of them, we're sure. The stories all describe the same prize; it can only be in one of them. We voted. The caves.""We were wrong, or we were early. It is no shrine — it is a catacomb, cut deep under the hill, the dead laid in rows in the walls. And they did not stay in them. They came up at us with unholy weapons. Aldous's wounds closed, but he did not mend. Edda would not leave him. We three made for the surface. Gods forgive us.""Camped at some old temple in the woods. Something is stalking us. I took a nap and I slept normal — dreams are OK now. Now I'm on watch. Cats keep circling the light. They sit beyond the light and do not eat what they kill. Sera says we make for the village at first light."The last entry is a hasty scrawl, the pen dragged across the page:"They're here! Time to arms!"

content: First Light Martial Melee • Sap A dawnbringer's blade, consecrated in a temple of Lathander at the hour of first light — its fuller inlaid with rose-gold that catches the faintest dawn.In a righteous hand its edge kindles with the pale fire of morning, cutting not with steel but with light. A paladin of the Morninglord carried it east down the Trade Way and never came back, and a hobgoblin captain took it as a trophy, blind to the warmth still sleeping in the steel.Once between dawns its bearer may call on the Morninglord's grace, and the blade's light pours into a single companion — a dawnfire courage that no fear can touch, steeling heart and body anew with every breath it burns. content: First Light Martial Melee • Sap A dawnbringer's blade, consecrated in a temple of Lathander at the hour of first light — its fuller inlaid with rose-gold that catches the faintest dawn.In a righteous hand its edge kindles with the pale fire of morning, cutting not with steel but with light. A paladin of the Morninglord carried it east down the Trade Way and never came back, and a hobgoblin captain took it as a trophy, blind to the warmth still sleeping in the steel.Once between dawns its bearer may call on the Morninglord's grace, and the blade's light pours into a single companion — a dawnfire courage that no fear can touch, steeling heart and body anew with every breath it burns. content: Shield Master General Feat You gain the following benefits.Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.Shield Bash. If you attack a creature within 5 feet of you as part of the Attack action and hit with a Melee weapon, you can immediately bash the target with your Shield if it’s equipped, forcing the target to make a Strength saving throw (DC 8 plus your Strength modifier and Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, you either push the target 5 feet from you or cause it to have the Prone condition (your choice). You can use this benefit only once on each of your turns.Interpose Shield.
